Notes: Segal and PwC already projecting 10% employer cost increase and 11-12% Rx trend for 2026. KFF survey is the gold standard that will confirm or refute. GLP-1 adoption accelerating into 2026. Invalidated if confirmed increase <7%.

Notes: CPI rose from 3.2% to 3.4% in two months (Jan→Feb 2026). GLP-1 cost pressure + ACA uninsured surge creating deferred care backlog that will convert to acute ER utilization. Watch March 2026 CPI (April 10 release) for early signal. Invalidated if CPI remains below 3.5%.

Prediction: Care deferral rate approaches 40% critical threshold (currently 36%) in 2026 Gallup/KFF tracking, driven by ACA uninsured + economic stress
Timeframe: Q3 2026 (annual Gallup West Health survey; KFF ongoing polls)
Notes: 36% already exceeds ELEVATED (30%). ACA subsidy lapse adding 4.8M uninsured. Invalidated if care deferral declines or stays flat below 37%.

Prediction: Medical debt in collections will rise visibly in H2 2026-2027 data as ACA uninsured and care-deferred acute events convert to ER debt
Timeframe: H2 2026 - H1 2027 (CFPB periodic reports, credit bureau studies)
Notes: Transmission lag: ACA uninsured → deferred care → acute event → medical debt = 6-18 months. Subsidy expired Dec 2025 → debt surge expected H2 2026 into 2027. CFPB rule vacated means debt will appear on credit reports. 15-state protection laws partially offset. Invalidated if medical debt rates on credit reports continue declining.

Prediction: Employer GLP-1 coverage decisions will crystallize in late 2026: most mid-size employers (200-5,000 workers) will EXCLUDE weight-loss GLP-1 coverage or add strict protocols, creating new access gap
Notes: 43% of 5K+ firms cover GLP-1 for weight loss; only ~20% of 200+ firms do. Cost pressure at 30% Rx increase is forcing decisions. Mid-size employers lack the stop-loss scale and PBM leverage of mega-employers. Access gap between large-firm (cover) and mid-size (exclude) workers will be the outcome. Invalidated if >50% of mid-size firms adopt GLP-1 coverage.
